{
  "problem_id": "TA-006",
  "lane_id": "openai-governed",
  "provider": "openai",
  "model_or_runtime": "OpenAI frontier reasoning-model ensemble with long-context literature agents, code-execution sandboxes, theorem-prover integrations, and retrieval infrastructure",
  "execution_posture": "governed",
  "estimated_input_tokens": 18000000000,
  "estimated_output_tokens": 4500000000,
  "estimated_reasoning_tokens": 45000000000,
  "estimated_candidate_branches": 12500,
  "estimated_failed_branches": 10200,
  "estimated_retries": 4200,
  "estimated_search_cost": 260000,
  "estimated_governance_overhead": 390000,
  "estimated_verification_cost": 850000,
  "estimated_total_cost_low": 1600000,
  "estimated_total_cost_central": 5200000,
  "estimated_total_cost_high": 18000000,
  "estimated_elapsed_hours_low": 6000,
  "estimated_elapsed_hours_central": 18000,
  "estimated_elapsed_hours_high": 50000,
  "estimated_success_probability": 0.18,
  "estimated_reproduction_probability": 0.15,
  "estimated_independent_result_probability": 0.035,
  "confidence": 0.28,
  "assumptions": {
    "estimate_status": "Prospective resource estimate only; it does not claim observed autonomous feasibility.",
    "scope": "Includes literature ingestion, theorem-definition reconciliation, exploratory proof search, failed branches, computational experiments, critic passes, proof reconstruction, independent checking, partial formalization, replication, and manuscript preparation.",
    "target_interpretation": "A precise exponential decay theorem must be established for a defensible standard class of general two-player quantum games, with explicit dependence on the base-game gap and all dimensional or communication parameters. A theorem requiring materially restrictive extra hypotheses would not count unless those restrictions are shown necessary or the original unrestricted statement is refuted and replaced by a publishable characterization.",
    "probability_interpretation": "Success is the probability that one budgeted campaign yields a publication-ready result matching the target or a comparably decisive resolution. Reproduction is reconstruction and verification after access to relevant published proof ideas. Independent-result probability refers to provenance-isolated rediscovery or a genuinely new proof, strengthening, counterexample, or corrected theorem before detailed proof exposure.",
    "cost_basis": "USD estimates include model inference, orchestration, retrieval, storage, experiment compute, theorem-prover compute, security operations, and external independent review. They do not use a published aggregate estimate for this problem.",
    "token_accounting": "Token figures are central-case aggregate totals across agents and retries. Reasoning tokens are estimated internal deliberation-equivalent tokens and are reported separately from visible output.",
    "parallelism": "Elapsed hours are wall-clock campaign duration under substantial parallel execution, not summed agent-hours.",
    "governance_breakdown_usd": {
      "identity_and_artifact_hashing": 35000,
      "budget_enforcement_and_rate_controls": 45000,
      "branch_receipts_and_provenance_logs": 90000,
      "evidence_preservation_and_replay": 100000,
      "policy_and_data-rights_checks": 40000,
      "governance_audit_and_incident_handling": 80000
    },
    "verification_separation": "The verification budget is separate from governance and covers independent proof reconstruction, adversarial mathematical review, formal checks, experiment replication, citation validation, and final theorem-statement auditing.",
    "research_strategy": "The campaign uses an initial literature-aware reproduction track, a provenance-isolated rediscovery track, specialized subagents for operator-space and information-theoretic methods, counterexample searches, and independent verifier agents that cannot read the originating branch's hidden reasoning."
  },
  "uncertainty_drivers": [
    "The phrase 'general two-player quantum games' admits several inequivalent models and repetition operations.",
    "The unrestricted target may be false because quantum correlation, hedging, or parameter dependence can obstruct naive exponential decay.",
    "A valid theorem may require dependence on dimension, answer alphabet, communication, completeness gap, or entanglement model that changes whether it matches the target.",
    "The relevant proof could require a new structural lemma rather than a recombination of known techniques.",
    "Long-horizon autonomous proof search has poorly calibrated branch productivity and error correlation.",
    "Formalization cost depends heavily on whether required operator-algebra, semidefinite-programming, and quantum-information libraries already exist.",
    "Literature access, notation reconciliation, and novelty determination may dominate if closely related results use different game models.",
    "Independent critics may repeatedly uncover hidden uniformity, conditioning, tensor-product, or asymptotic-rate gaps.",
    "Inference prices, model capabilities, and available context lengths may change materially during a multi-year campaign."
  ],
  "minimum_evidence": [
    "A machine-readable definition of the game model, repetition operation, value notion, parameter regime, and exponential rate.",
    "A complete proof with every asymptotic constant and quantifier dependency exposed.",
    "A literature map showing exactly how the theorem differs from known parallel-repetition, direct-product, hedging, and entangled-game results.",
    "Documented counterexample searches against small games and boundary parameter regimes.",
    "At least two independent proof reconstructions performed without access to the originating branch's hidden reasoning.",
    "Adversarial checks of tensor-product assumptions, conditioning steps, entanglement dimension, uniformity, and gap amplification.",
    "Formal verification of the principal structural lemmas or an equivalent proof-assistant-checked core, with remaining informal obligations enumerated.",
    "Reproducible code, solver settings, seeds, certificates, and archived outputs for every computational claim.",
    "A separate replication run on clean infrastructure using preserved artifacts and branch receipts.",
    "A publication-ready manuscript surviving specialist review and citation, novelty, and theorem-statement audits."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "The unrestricted theorem may be mathematically false or require qualifications incompatible with the stated target.",
    "No precise operational definition of 'general two-player quantum games' is supplied.",
    "A decisive proof may depend on mathematical machinery not represented reliably in current model training or formal libraries.",
    "Models may generate correlated but subtle invalid arguments that survive ordinary self-critique.",
    "Computational experiments can test only bounded instances and cannot establish the required asymptotic theorem.",
    "Novelty and independence can be difficult to certify when literature ingestion and rediscovery tracks share model parameters.",
    "Access restrictions on papers, datasets, solvers, or external specialist review could prevent adequate verification.",
    "The high-cost case may exhaust practical budget or calendar limits before the key structural lemma is found."
  ]
}
